text:
lexi (Product Designer): quick sync on API Keys modal — when an org has 10+ role tags the multiselect becomes a scrolling mess. users lose context of what scopes they picked.

pat (PM): noticed support tickets where customers thought roles were sticky per-user. can we add a short note 'roles apply to this key' near selections? tiny change but reduces confusion. :memo:

omar (Frontend): i saw a keyboard issue: arrow navigation in the dropdown traps focus inside the virtual list. also the chips don't expose a clear remove target for keyboard-only users.

sue (A11y): NVDA/VoiceOver tests: chips announce as static text only. need role count announced and the remove button labelled "remove role <role>". also add `aria-live` feedback like "3 roles selected" on change.

lexi (Product Designer): proposal: show a condensed pill row (max 5 visible) + a "+N more" button that opens a small modal with full list and checkboxes. keeps main flow tidy. add a tiny explanatory line: "These roles will be granted to the key."

pat (PM): +1. for broad scopes we should surface a stronger inline banner (icon + orange background). current subtle copy isn't getting clicks. can we include a one-line risk explanation and a link to best-practices?

omar (Frontend): implementation notes: condensed pills can be CSS-only for layout, but the "+N more" must be accessible — use a button that opens a dialog with focus trap and `role=dialog`. will fix arrow trap by delegating key handlers to the list container.

sue (A11y): prefer dialog with `aria-modal=true` and focus sent to first interactive item. ensure close button is labelled. also ensure color contrast for the orange banner passes at least AA for normal text; small caption needs stronger weight.

lexi (Product Designer): draft banner copy:

"Heads up: This key grants wide access (e.g., admin.*). Use only for services you control. Learn why"

pat (PM): maybe replace 'Learn why' with a tooltip/disclosure so we don't send people to docs too often. inline help preferred.

omar (Frontend): can do a small disclosure that toggles `aria-expanded`. when expanded, it reveals one-sentence rationale. will also add `data-telemetry="role_overflow_open"` on the "+N more" button.

sue (A11y): checklist for this change:
- condensed pill row keyboard focus order
- "+N more" button announces count and opens dialog
- dialog receives focus and announces title
- remove buttons labelled and reachable by tab
- `aria-live` polite region for counts
- banner contrast and focus styles

lexi (Product Designer): empty state idea for Keys page: big CTA "Create your first API key" plus 2-line helper: "Assign minimal roles. Rotate keys regularly." keep it friendly and short.

pat (PM): telemetry requests: create_modal_open, create_submit, overflow_open, banner_ack. also event for empty-state-click. helps us measure conversion.

omar (Frontend): will add telemetry and `data-testid` attrs. planning a small PR: fix/compact-pills-ux. aiming for tests + a11y fixes.

ci-bot: build for branch "fix/compact-pills-ux" completed 12 tests run, 2 failing (accessibility). see https://ci.internal/reports/456

sue (A11y): i'll take the failing tests. likely announcements or focus order. will iterate on PR comments.

lexi (Product Designer): thanks all — i'll push updated mocks to the thread and include the microcopy variations for the banner and empty state. :thumbsup:
